description: Sentient emerald: deep emerald facet cores that darken from the up-facing crown to the down-facing pavilion, brighter gem-green edge planes whose seams glow softly, concave inner facets lit from within, two glowing eye facets, and a floating core gem that burns brightest.

pavilion.note: down-facing facet cores - darkest emerald (core planes)

edge.note: edge planes / crystal seams - bright gem green, soft glow

inner.note: concave inner facets (sunk below the hull) - lit from within

eye.note: the two sunk eye gems - hot green glow

core.note: floating core gem facets - burning emerald
